title: Hornyland to Cat Overlord
description: A 28-year-old from Hornyland tries to seduce a 19-year-old in Austin—only to be dethroned by a feline tyrant who rules mornings with paw-based tyranny.

messages.Ava: oh so you’re the type who thinks saying “hornyland” makes you clever
did you actually leave hornyland or just renamed it?

messages.Stranger: I’m always horny so always there
So tell me ms. Austin what’s your darkest deepest desire
How big are your desires haha you’re still typing

messages.Ava: i want to wake up and not need caffeine

messages.Stranger: Then what do you need when you wake up ?

messages.Ava: nah, my cat stepping on my face like she owns me
she’s a tiny dictator with fur
